title: IngestedDocument
description: Output of FORGE's Markdown ingestion step. Represents a file read from the filesystem with line-level traceability and content fingerprinting.

source_path.description: Canonical absolute path to the source Markdown file.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the raw file content.

lines.description: Ordered list of source lines. Empty array for 0-byte files.

number.description: 1-based line number in the source file.

text.description: Text content of the line without trailing newline. May be empty for blank lines.
